newsitem.title: USA: USDA March 11 U.S. crop highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: USDA March 11 U.S. crop highlights - USDA.

text.p: U.S. soybean ending stocks for 1996/97 were left unchanged at 140 million bushels, but soybean crush was raised 10 million bushels to a record 1.42 billion bushels to reflect strong product demand, the U.S. Agriculture Department said Tuesday.
In its March U.S. supply and demand report, USDA said soybean exports were lowered slightly from last month's estimate to 900 million bushels.
With the exception of a slight adjustment in its average wheat price, USDA left unchanged its supply and demand estimates for corn and wheat in 1996/97.
U.S. 1996/97 cotton exports were pegged at 6.80 million bales, up 30,000 bales, and ending stocks were lowered to 4.15 million bales from the previous month's 4.45 million.
